move: browser mockup rises with overshoot, captions rise from masks, quick lift out
how: A square cream stage with a browser-window mockup holding a photo hero. In one second the mockup rises 120px from scale 0.94 and opacity 0 (expo.out 0.55s) while its page body slides up within it (yPercent 20, expo.out 0.8s) for a parallax feel; a small label and the two-part caption rise out of overflow masks (yPercent 120 to 0, expo.out, 60ms stagger) between 5% and 18%. At 78% the mockup lifts 40px and fades (power3.in 0.25s) and the text lines drop up out of their masks (yPercent -120, 30ms stagger).
adapt: Replace the URL, hero text, screenshot image, label and caption strings; the mockup size and radius are CSS. Keep the 0.55s expo.out rise and the 0.25s exit, scaled with D.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the label, mockup and caption inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with entry at 0-0.2 of D and exit at 0.78 of D; the 1s base is very short, so D should stay near 1-1.5s.
caveats: from() tweens; use immediateRender:false if built after first paint
